body_markdown:
DALLAS, Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ —[NexPoint](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=2412866772&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2F&a=NexPoint) , a multibillion-dollar alternative investment firm, today announced that it has fully subscribed its NexPoint Oasis DST (the “Offering”), a Delaware statutory trust (“DST”) offering. The offering was comprised of Oasis at Shingle Creek, a Class A, garden-style multifamily community located in Kissimmee, Florida.


The Offering raised approximately $46.3 million in equity through the firm’s 1031 exchange platform. Developed in 2018, Oasis at Shingle Creek features resort-style amenities, private entries, direct-access garages, and modern unit interiors. The community is located in one of the fastest-growing metropolitan areas in the United States, benefiting from strong population growth, job creation, and sustained demand for quality rental housing.


“The successful full subscription of NexPoint Oasis DST reflects continued investor interest in high-quality multifamily assets located in markets with strong long-term fundamentals,” said Matt McGraner, Chief Investment Officer and Executive Vice President of NexPoint. “We believe the property’s location, quality, and surrounding demographic trends resonated with investors seeking institutional real estate opportunities.”


The successful closing of NexPoint Oasis DST builds on the continued growth of[NexPoint’s DST and 1031 exchange platform](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=1465572276&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexpoint.com%2Fdsts-1031-exchange%2F&a=NexPoint%27s+DST+and+1031+exchange+platform) , which comprises multiple sectors, including multifamily, self-storage, life sciences, industrial, hospitality, marinas, and energy. Through these specialized offerings, NexPoint provides accredited investors with access to institutional-quality real estate assets through tax-advantaged structures.


**About NexPoint**


NexPoint is a multibillion-dollar investment firm based in Dallas, Texas. The firm is structured around three major business areas:[real estate](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=1914754505&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4530920-1%26h%3D1383517243%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nexpoint.com%252Four-businesses%252Freal-estate%252F%26a%3Dreal%2Bestate&a=real+estate) ,[corporate credit and equities](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=845288989&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4530920-1%26h%3D1817686801%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nexpoint.com%252Four-businesses%252Fcorporate-credit-equities%252F%26a%3Dcorporate%2Bcredit%2Band%2Bequities&a=corporate+credit+and+equities) , and[retirement solutions](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=435471739&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4530920-1%26h%3D2673817255%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nexpoint.com%252Four-businesses%252Finsurance-solutions%252F%26a%3Dretirement%2Bsolutions&a=retirement+solutions) . NexPoint’s businesses span asset classes, industries, and strategies, providing the flexibility to invest across capital structures and market environments. Serving a diverse client base, NexPoint’s investment strategies are offered in a range of vehicles and fund structures, including mutual funds, public and private REITs, tax-advantaged vehicles, private funds, and separate accounts. For more information, including important risks and disclosures, visit[nexpoint.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4791268-1&h=2860491662&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4530920-1%26h%3D3604372246%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.nexpoint.com%252F%26a%3Dnexpoint.com&a=nexpoint.com) .
